description: Implement a feature flag system to control a new Stripe payment integration in a Flask app. Your task: (1) Create a .env file in /home/ga/workspace/payment_app/ with the variable USE_STRIPE_PAYMENT set to either 'false' or 'true'. (2) Modify app.py to read this environment variable (use python-dotenv library with load_dotenv() and os.getenv()). (3) Update the /checkout endpoint in app.py to conditionally call either process_payment_stripe(amount) if the flag is enabled or process_payment_legacy(amount) if disabled, using an if-else statement. (4) Add logging statements using logger.info() to track which payment processor is being used (e.g., 'Processing payment with Stripe' or 'Processing payment with legacy processor'). (5) Ensure both the Stripe and legacy code paths are functional. The files payment_processor.py and .env.example are already provided. You need to create the .env file and modify app.py to implement the feature flag logic.
